g.text: Figure 3: CAMS clearness index against each ERA5 cloud cover

g.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Six NGED solar farms, daylight hours, September 2019 to June 2026. ERA5: ECMWF's reanalysis of past weather. CAMS: satellite irradiance service. Line: mean clearness index in each 0.05-wide band of cloud cover. Band: 10th to 90th percentile. Clearness index: irradiance divided by the irradiance at the top of the atmosphere.'
